fields.System.Title: INT-402 — Throughput by hour
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want to see how much work was completed each hour, so that I
can staff to the real shape of the day and judge whether changes helped.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then lines picked, units received, and putaways completed are
  • shown per hour.
  • - Given the report, then it can be broken down by zone and by operator count.
  • - Given the data, then lines per operator hour is derived so productivity is comparable
  • across shifts of different sizes.
  • - Given a process change on a known date, then before-and-after comparison is possible.
  • - Given the report, then it is built from a daily read model.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, outbound, inbound |
| Tables | throughput projection, stock_movement |
| Risks | Optimising without a baseline ([doc 07 §7](../../../docs/07-phased-delivery-plan.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
